summary: Sky Harbour Group Corp filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 4,000,000 shares of Class A common stock at $10.00 per share, raising gross proceeds of $40 million. The shares are sold directly to certain investors without a placement agent, with estimated expenses of $150,000. The offering price represents a discount to the August 11, 2026 closing price of $11.21. Shares are expected to deliver on August 12, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, so no special-situation classification applies.
